verdicts_or_reports.expected: With night owl mode on and times of day at 8:30 PM, the preview still lists today's 8:30 PM dose (Today, then Tomorrow). Night owl only shifts doses before 04:00, so it should not affect an 8:30 PM dose.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: With night owl mode off the preview shows "8:30 PM Today" and "8:30 PM Tomorrow". Turning night owl on drops the Today entry: the preview becomes "8:30 PM Tomorrow" and "8:30 PM Nov 15 Sun". Reproduced twice. Start date Nov 14, current time 12:09.
steps: Plan tab > Add group (Nov 14 start date, start time left at default and changed to 6:08 PM).
Add medication Estradiol valerate (Oral, 1 mg) to the group.
Set the Times of day entry to 8:30 PM.
With Night owl mode off, observe PREVIEW: 8:30 PM Today, 8:30 PM Tomorrow.
Turn Night owl mode on: PREVIEW shows 8:30 PM Tomorrow and 8:30 PM Nov 15 Sun; today's dose is gone.
Turn Night owl mode off again: Today entry returns.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Home and Plan agree on today's doses. Plan's Nov 14 (SAT · TODAY) card lists the Estradiol valerate 8:30 PM dose (0/1), so Home should list it under TODAY, or Plan should not show it there.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Home under "TODAY / NOV 14 SAT" shows "Nothing scheduled today." and the 8:30 PM dose appears only under "TOMORROW". Plan on the same day (Nov 14) shows the Estradiol valerate Oral · 1 mg 8:30 PM entry with "0/1".
